name: phasis/phasis
description: Pure PHP JavaScript engine. Lexes, parses, and executes ECMAScript without Node.js, FFI, or extensions.

suggest.ext-intl: Required for Intl.* APIs (Collator, NumberFormat, DateTimeFormat, etc.) and full Temporal calendar support. Without it, Intl constructors throw and non-ISO calendars fall back to limited semantics.
suggest.ext-openssl: Required for WebCrypto AES/RSA/EC operations and Node TLS/HTTPS/secure HTTP2 transports.
suggest.ext-sodium: Required for WebCrypto Ed25519 key generation, signing, and verification.
suggest.ext-zlib: Required for Node gzip/deflate compression and decompression. Brotli uses the bundled JavaScript codec.
